metadata.title: The Parable of the Ant
metadata.kicker: Why the complexity was the beach, not the ant — and what that means for AI
metadata.brand: CLAUDE (cream #FAF9F5 / #F2F0E9 stage, warm ink #3D3929, terracotta #D97757 spark)
metadata.est_note: estimate at ~2.9 wps for narration beats; measured audio is the only clock

render.rule: BASE RULE — EVERY beat native 4K. Author ALL Manim compositions at 1920x1080 (-qh -r 1920,1080); compile.py scales 2× to 3840x2160. No 1280x720 comps. No ffmpeg bicubic upscaling.
render.qc: ffprobe every beat clip: reject any beat whose native stream is not 3840x2160 (or 1920x1080 pre-scale).

content_rules.no_pantry: HARD RULE — zero pantry stills, zero gen-AI, zero screengrabs. Every visual is Manim or Remotion (code-generated). No exceptions.
content_rules.no_placeholder_text: HARD RULE — no beat may ship with placeholder text ('⚠ SET IN BEAT SHEET', 'Manim', default slate titles). Any such text in a compiled frame is a build failure.
content_rules.manim_scope: MANIM for all body content beats — animations, diagrams, simulations, equations, path traces. Every Manim beat has an authored scene_class in scenes.py.
content_rules.remotion_scope: REMOTION for bookends (B00, act-title FormACard cards, BVDT, BHTF, BOUT) only.
content_rules.no_external_names_exception: Scholarly attribution exception: Simon, Wehner, Brooks, Cataglyphis are named where required for academic attribution. This overrides the tool-author no-names rule, which applies to software tools. See BUILD-LOG.md.
content_rules.factcheck: All narration claims are from the VERIFIED column of FACTCHECK.md or stated at appropriate generality. Chapter numbers and specific numbers from Wehner are omitted.

metadata.gate_state: PLAN — beat sheet written 2026-08-12. Awaiting Bear review before audio generation.
